recap.paragraph: In Dallas, the 49ers and Cowboys chased a big win. Brock Purdy zipped a 74-yard touchdown pass to Christian McCaffrey! Then Deebo Samuel raced 70 yards for another 49ers touchdown. The 49ers led 38-19 in the fourth quarter, but Dallas was determined. The Cowboys scored 3 touchdowns, with Dak Prescott finding CeeDee Lamb for the last one! San Francisco held on to win 46-40. The 49ers climbed to 8-1, while Dallas fell to 4-6.
